name: University of Technology Sydney
description: The University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a public university in central Sydney, established as a university in 1988, with its campus in Ultimo next to the city centre. It is known for engineering, IT, business, design, health and communication.
whyIncluded: The Australian Government's indicative allocation lets UTS enrol about 5,350 new international students in 2026, a sign of strong international demand.

livingCosts.summary: UTS's own Sydney cost-of-living guide: a room in shared accommodation near UTS, food, public transport, utilities, phone and entertainment for 12 months, using the middle of each range UTS quotes. Excludes OSHC, tuition and set-up costs.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A: UTS international student guide 'Cost of living in Sydney' (canonical URL above; reached via /study/international/commencing-students/living-sydney/costs-living), read 2026-10-13. 'At a glance' table, 'Monthly cost (AUD)', figures based on Study Australia's cost of living calculator: accommodation $1,200-$3,400; food and groceries $400-$800; utilities and internet $150-$400; transport $130-$800; lifestyle and entertainment $350-$650; mobile phone plans $30-$100. The page also gives shared accommodation near UTS at $370-$550 a week. Housing = midpoint of the shared-accommodation range (A$460/week x 52/12 = 1,993.33), per the method's single-room rule; the monthly accommodation range (midpoint 2,300) covers whole dwellings and was not used. Food = midpoint 600; transport = midpoint 465; personal = utilities and internet midpoint 275 + lifestyle midpoint 500 + phone midpoint 65 = 840. Textbooks (A$400+, no period) excluded, as are OSHC, tuition and one-off set-up costs. Total about A$3,898/month (A$46,780/year), above the Home Affairs visa minimum of A$29,710.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.summary: 2027 tuition for international students for a full-time year (two sessions). Excludes the student services fee and overseas student health cover; UTS raises fees each calendar year.
programmes.notes: UTS course C09066 (CRICOS 084098A), '2027 International Undergraduate Course Summary Table' PDF on uts.edu.au ('Information is correct as of June 2026'), read 2026-10-13: 'Course Fee (A$/Session)' A$28,620 for 2027, course duration 8 sessions. Annual = per-session fee x 2 sessions (UTS full-time year = 48 credit points = 2 sessions of 24 credit points; UTS course pages state '1 year = 48 credit points'). Excludes SSAF and OSHC. UTS course pages show domestic fees only and the international fee search (cis.uts.edu.au/fees/course-fees.cfm) is a form that could not be queried; only the current (2027) summary tables are published at a fixed URL, so no 2024 or 2025 international fee was found and there is no feeHistory. City campus (Ultimo). The table lists one row for the BE (Honours); majors are not priced separately. 2024-2026 still unfilled (2026-10-13, unofficial search): Uni Enrol's 'UTS Fees & Courses In 2026' article (Feb 2026) gives per-year figures labelled 2026 that sit about 9.2% below UTS's own 2027 table for almost every course, while Hotcourses lists figures about 4.5% below 2027 under 2027 intakes, so the Uni Enrol figures look like 2025 fees mislabelled as 2026 and were not used; the cis.uts.edu.au fee search offers 2026 but could not be queried, and no agent mirror of an earlier UTS course summary table was found. 2025 row (2026-10-13, official): UTS's 2025 International Undergraduate Course Guide (uts.edu.au/international-undergraduate-course-guide, 'Information is correct as at January 2024') lists C09066 at A$26,205 per session; its tuition section says 'Fees listed are correct for 2025 only', although the course-table footnotes still say 'correct for 2024 only'. The figures are taken as 2025 fees because every one sits exactly 9.2% below the 2027 table, the same step as UTS's 2025 PG guide figures (which say 2025 only in every table) to 2027. Annual = per-session fee x 2. 2026 row (2026-10-13, rung 3): Chinese agent site oneuedu.com (oneuedu.com/courses/bachelor-of-engineering-honours-084098A, updated 2026/10/08) states the fee for '国际留学生（境内） · 2026' as A$54,770 a year; it is above the official 2025 figure (A$52,410) and below the official 2027 figure (A$57,240), equal to neither, and sits the same ~4.3% below 2027 as every other UTS course on that site, consistent with one 2026 schedule. Taken as the annual (2-session) fee. oneuedu's 2026 labels are not always right for other universities (its USyd Master of Commerce '2026' A$62,706 differs from USyd's official 2026 A$61,700), so the row is marked unofficial. Round 4 (2026-10-13): no copy of UTS's 2024 international UG guide was found (searched agent flipbook hosts), and UAC's international course pages render fees only via script.

programmes.notes: UTS course C04018 (CRICOS 025004A), '2027 International Postgraduate Course Summary Table' PDF on uts.edu.au ('Information is correct as of June 2026'), read 2026-10-13: 'Course Fee (A$/Session)' A$27,295 for 2027, course duration 4 sessions. Annual = per-session fee x 2 sessions (UTS full-time year = 48 credit points = 2 sessions of 24 credit points; the PG table states 'Fees shown are based on 24 credit points per session. Fees are correct for 2027 only and are subject to an increase each calendar year'). Excludes SSAF and OSHC. UTS course pages show domestic fees only and the international fee search (cis.uts.edu.au/fees/course-fees.cfm) is a form that could not be queried; only the current (2027) summary tables are published at a fixed URL, so no 2024 or 2025 international fee was found and there is no feeHistory. City campus (Ultimo). 2024-2026 still unfilled (2026-10-13, unofficial search): Uni Enrol's 'UTS Fees & Courses In 2026' article (Feb 2026) gives per-year figures labelled 2026 that sit about 9.2% below UTS's own 2027 table for almost every course, while Hotcourses lists figures about 4.5% below 2027 under 2027 intakes, so the Uni Enrol figures look like 2025 fees mislabelled as 2026 and were not used; the cis.uts.edu.au fee search offers 2026 but could not be queried, and no agent mirror of an earlier UTS course summary table was found. 2024 row (2026-10-13, unofficial): yunzhan365.com hosts a copy of UTS's International Postgraduate Course Guide (uploaded by agent Global Education; printed June 2023) whose tables state 'Fees listed are correct for 2024 only' and list C04018 at A$24,035 per session; annual = x 2. 2025 row (2026-10-13, official): UTS's 2025 International Postgraduate Course Guide (uts.edu.au/international-pg-course-guide; 'Fees listed are correct for 2025 only') lists C04018 at A$24,995 per session; annual = x 2. 2026 row (2026-10-13, rung 3): Chinese agent site oneuedu.com (oneuedu.com/courses/master-of-business-administration-025004A, updated 2026/10/08) states the fee for '国际留学生（境内） · 2026' as A$52,240 a year; it is above the official 2025 figure (A$49,990) and below the official 2027 figure (A$54,590), equal to neither, and sits the same ~4.3% below 2027 as every other UTS course on that site, consistent with one 2026 schedule. Taken as the annual (2-session) fee. oneuedu's 2026 labels are not always right for other universities (its USyd Master of Commerce '2026' A$62,706 differs from USyd's official 2026 A$61,700), so the row is marked unofficial.
